body: In Rihanna’s old video she said this was the most “unpretty” cover she ever did — and that’s exactly why she loved it. “It’s not about how smooth or perfect I look… it’s about what my eyes say.” The tongue out, the attitude, the rawness — she didn’t care if it wasn’t cute… she had something to say. rihanna.
